evidence.name: Screen field: The video for this screen
evidence.userNeed: Know what "The video for this screen" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: The video for this screen
sections.description: Add a video by uploading a file or pasting a direct video URL. Keep it short (a few seconds, ideally under ~30s) and lightweight so the page loads fast — long or heavy videos hurt conversion on paid traffic. Uploads are converted automatically to play reliably across devices, and you can pair this with the loop option below to replay it continuously.
